item.title: Body found on side of Phoenix road prompts homicide investigation
item.description: Phoenix Police are investigating a homicide after a body was found on the side of the road. Officers responded to a call near 5600 West Broadway Road regarding "an object on the side of the road that appeared to be a body" at around 10:49 p.m. on Feb. 6. At the scene, they found the object wrapped in "large amounts of material," but initially couldn't determine what it was.
